description.value: Prado Coffee is a Vancouver specialty coffee brand founded by Sammy Piccolo, a four-time Canadian Barista Champion who has represented Canada at the World Barista Championships. What began as a single shop on Commercial Drive has grown into a network of neighbourhood cafes across Vancouver, Burnaby, and Surrey, each focused on craft espresso and fresh baked goods. The Dunbar Street location brings that same community-first ethos to a residential cycling corridor on the west side of Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Prado Coffee operates a Dunbar Street location, matching the OSM address. The About page notes the brand evolved from 'Prado Cafe' to 'Prado Coffee,' explaining the name discrepancy in OSM. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or most amenities are mentioned on the website; 'Order & Pickup' in the site navigation confirms takeout is available.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Prado Cafe' but website and About page consistently use 'Prado Coffee,' with the About page explicitly stating 'Prado Cafe has evolved to Prado Coffee.' OSM name may be outdated.
Phone 604-336-9277 sourced from website contact-information page (corporate listing at Fraser Street HQ); OSM has no phone entry. Cannot confirm this number is specific to the Dunbar location.

Website contact-information page lists corporate address as 4208 Fraser Street, Vancouver BC V5V 4G2 — different from OSM's 4498 Dunbar Street. The Fraser Street address appears to be the corporate/HQ address rather than the Dunbar location address, but the Dunbar location street number is not independently confirmed by the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active multi-location coffee business with a confirmed Dunbar Street location; useful stop for touring cyclists.
